event: 2026 ILCA 6 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: The international jury, upon receipt of a report from the Pauline Den Burger (member international jury), decided to call a hearing to consider whether a support person had broken a rule.
The international jury was represented by Pauline Den Burger.
Coach vessel 72 was represented by Sonke Herrmann (coach of GER and registered driver of coach vessel 72).
Competitor supported by Sonke Herrmann who attended the hearing was GER 227602 (Youth Men Gold fleet).

Competitors supported by Sonke Herrmann who did not attend the hearing were GER 224473 (Youth Men Silver fleet) and GER 223704, GER 212977, GER 219920, GER 220759 (all of whom were racing on race area Bravo). The hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: After the starting signal was displayed during the first attempt of the starting procedure for race 9 of ILCA 6 Youth Men (Gold fleet), the race committee displayed the First Substitute for a general recall.
After the general recall, the international jury observed that coach vessel 72 was positioned 10 meters leeward of the starting line.
Sonke Herrmann, the registered driver of coach vessel 72, was talking to the competitor of GER 227602.
The international jury asked Sonke Herrman to move away from the starting line and he immediately drove coach vessel 72 away accordingly.
Sonke Herrmann apologised for the incident before he moved away from the starting line.
conclusions: By being 10m leeward of the starting line after a general recall, Sonke Herrmann (coach of GER and registered driver of coach vessel 72) broke Support Vessel Regulation (SVR) 5.1.2. (Attachment 2 to the Notice of Race).
decision: Sonke Herrmann, coach of GER and registered driver of coach vessel 72, is to be anchored 100 meters leeward of the race committee starting vessel, from the first warning signal for the Youth Men Gold fleet on race day 6 till the Youth Men Gold and Silver fleets have finished race 11 or until flag V is displayed or a member of the jury releases him.
GER 224473 and GER 227602 are warned under RRS 62.4 that a penalty may be imposed if Sonke Herrmann commits a further breach of any rule. Decision
